blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.
blocks.zh: 互动的世界模型产生以用户行动为条件的可视内容,但实时在长视距探索中保持空间一致性仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法依赖时间上下文或明确的3D内存,两者的尺度都很差,因为内存随着所生成流的长度而增长. 此外,清晰的3D记忆通过重新编码RGB渲染来给潜伏的视频生成器附加条件,这排除了实时生成. 在本文中,我们引入了Latent 3D高斯记忆(L3G),它结合了向导重建的效率与紧凑,可快速渲染的场景表现. 基于这种记忆,我们提出L3G-World,其中内存更新器和视频扩散变压器(DIT)可自动递归来生成空间相容的世界. 内存更新器在新观测到的地区培育出高斯人并完善了已存在的地区,使内存随着场景范围而不是流长而增长. 每个高斯人还进一步存储了VAE潜伏特性,使得内存可以在没有VAE再编码的情况下被直接渲染入DiT潜伏空间. 实验显示,L3G-World实现了最先进的生成质量和长相空间相容性,最多能减少38.6\times的3D原始人, 3.2\times的内存更新速度快,359\times的内存渲染速度快于每公尺前最高效的3D-相模基线,能以9FPS的速度实现实时世界相容.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive video world models ( Seo et al., 2026 ; Nam et al., 2026 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Basant et al., 2026 ) , which generate visual content conditioned on user-provided actions, have recently emerged as a promising framework for real-world simulation ( Seo et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Basant et al., 2026 ) , interactive game generation ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , and embodied simulation ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . A central challenge lies in maintaining spatial consistency during long-horizon exploration and loop closures while still supporting real-time generation.
blocks.zh: 互动视频世界模式 (Seo等人,2026年;Nam等人,2026年;Bruce等人,2024年;Team等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年;Sun等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年;Basant等人,2026年),产生以用户提供的行动为条件的视觉内容,最近成为现实世界模拟的一个很有希望的框架(Seo等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年;Basant等人,2026年);互动游戏一代(Bruce等人,2024年;Team等人,2026年;Sun等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年),并体现了模拟(Agarwal等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年b). 一个中心挑战在于在长距离探索和环绕关闭期间保持空间一致性,同时仍然支持实时生成。

blocks.en: One line of work employ temporal context, by retrieving history frames or KV caches of self-attention layers in diffusion models during autoregressive generation ( Team et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) . By allowing each new chunk to attend to information from earlier generations through attention, these methods help maintain scene consistency ( Kwon et al., 2026 ) . However, its memory and attention costs grows with the length of the generated stream and spatial resolution. As shown in Tab. 1 , this linear growth makes long-horizon generation increasingly expensive and can eventually lead to out-of-memory failures.
blocks.zh: 一行工作采用时间背景,在自动递归生成过程中在扩散模型中检索历史帧或自留层的KV缓存(Team等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年;Yi等人,2026年). 这些方法允许每一个新块通过注意注意前代的信息,有助于保持场景的一致性(Kwon等人,2026年)。 然而,其内存和注意力成本随着生成的流和空间分辨率的长度而增加. 如Tab. 1所示,这种线性增长使得长视元代越来越昂贵,最终可能导致超模故障.

blocks.en: Another line of work explicitly stores scene information in persistent 3D representations. These approaches preserve previously generated content by reconstructing frames into point-cloud-based memories ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) or 3D Gaussian primitives ( De Lutio et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Such spatially anchored representations improve consistency across revisited regions while enabling fine-grained camera control. However, as shown in Tab. 1 , existing approaches exhibit a fundamental trade-off between reconstruction efficiency and throughput. Feed-forward methods based on per-pixel point clouds or Gaussian primitives enable fast scene reconstruction, but predicting dense 3D representations for every pixel introduces substantial memory overhead. As generation proceeds, these dense primitives are repeatedly accumulated over the same spatial regions, resulting in increasingly redundant scene representations and slower target-view rendering. Moreover, since previously stored primitives are not adaptively updated, geometrically inaccurate regions may persist over time. In contrast, optimization-based methods ( De Lutio et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) maintain more compact representations whose memory footprint primarily scales with scene extent, but their iterative optimization introduces substantial latency, making them unsuitable for real-time generation.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作明确将场景信息存储在持续的3D表达中. 这些方法通过将帧重建成点云记忆来保存以前产生的内容(Ren等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年a; Shen et al., 2026; Lee et al., 2026)或3D 高斯原始人(De Lutio et al., 2026;Wu et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026). 这种空间定位的表示方式提高了重新审视区域的一致性,同时能够进行精细的照相机控制。 然而,如附件1所示,现有办法显示出重建效率和吞吐量之间的根本权衡。 基于每像素点云或高斯原始物的Feed-forward方法使得快速场景重建成为可能,但预测每个像素密集的3D表示物会引入大量的内存上浮. 随着生成过程的发展,这些密集的原始物在相同的空间区域上反复积累,导致场景表现越来越冗余,靶景渲染速度也越来越慢. 此外,由于以前储存的原始物没有适应性更新,几何不准确的区域可能会长期存在. 相比之下,基于优化的方法(De Lutio等人,2026年;Wu等人,2025年)则保持了更紧凑的表达方式,其记忆足迹主要以场景范围为尺度,但其迭代优化引入了实质性的耐久性,使其不适合实时生成.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce a compact L atent 3 D G aussian Memory ( L3G ), which is continually read and updated online, and whose size grows primarily with the spatial extent of the explored scene rather than with the length of the generated stream. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World , a world-generation framework composed of two modules: a feed-forward memory updater L3G-Mem , and a memory-conditioned video diffusion transformer L3G-Gen .
As the two modules alternate autoregressively, L3G-Mem spawns new Gaussians only in uncovered regions, and refines the existing Gaussians in explored regions through residual updates. The memory is therefore not a buffer that accumulates primitives, but a persistent scene representation revised over time, which avoids redundant accumulation and progressively corrects geometrically inaccurate Gaussians. Since each Gaussian additionally stores a VAE latent feature, the memory is rendered directly into the latent space of L3G-Gen under the target cameras, conditioning the generation of the next video chunk without VAE re-encoding. The generated chunk is then fed back to L3G-Mem, which again updates the memory, closing the autoregressive loop. Combined with few-step distillation of L3G-Gen, this design enables real-time, long-horizon world generation.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了一个紧凑的L atent 3 D G Aussian Memory(L3G),它不断在线阅读和更新,其体积主要随着被探索场景的空间范围而不是产生的流的长度而增加. 基于这个记忆,我们提议L3G-World,一个由两个模块组成的世界代框架:一个Feed-forward内存更新器L3G-Mem,以及一个内存有条件的视频传播变压器L3G-Gen.
由于两个模块自动递归,L3G-Mem只在未发现的区域产出新的高斯人,并通过剩余更新来完善被探索区域现有的高斯人. 因此,记忆并不是一种积累原始物的缓冲,而是一种随时间推移而修改的持久场景表现,它避免了多余的积累,并逐渐纠正几何不准确的高斯人. 由于每个高斯人额外存储一个VAE潜伏特性,内存直接被制成L3G-Gen在目标摄像头下潜伏的空间,为产生下一个没有VAE重编码的视频块提供了条件. 生成的块随后反馈到L3G-Mem,它再次更新内存,关闭自递回循环. 与L3G-Gen的几步蒸馏相结合,这种设计能够实现实时,长视界的世界代.

blocks.en: Experiments demonstrate that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art long-horizon consistency and generation quality while using 26.7 26.7 – 38.9 × 38.9\times fewer 3D primitives, performing memory reconstruction 3.0 3.0 – 3.2 × 3.2\times faster, and providing 349 349 – 359 × 359\times higher VAE-space rendering throughput than the most efficient prior explicit 3D-memory baseline for each metric. Combined with few-step distillation of L3G-Gen, this enables real-time world generation at 9.02 FPS on one H100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 实验证明,L3G-World在使用26.7 26.7 — 38.9 × 38.9\次的3D原始数据的同时,实现了最先进的长视距一致性和生成质量,进行内存重建3.0 3.0 — 3.2 × 3.2\次的速度更快,提供349-359 — 359 × 359\次的VAE-空间渲染吞吐量比每公尺之前最高效的清晰的3D-映射基线要高. 与L3G-Gen的几步蒸馏相结合,使得一个H100 GPU上的9.02 FPS能够实时生成世界.

blocks.en:
Video Diffusion and World Models. Video diffusion models have made substantial progress in high-quality video generation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Ali et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ) .
Most adopt latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2021 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) , where raw videos are compressed into a latent space using a VAE.
Reducing the number of sampling steps, together with causal generation, has further enabled low-latency video streaming ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) .
They improve few-step generation by training on model-generated histories to mitigate exposure bias, or by combining flow-based transitions with on-policy distillation.
Building on these advances, interactive world models ( Seo et al., 2026 ; Nam et al., 2026 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Basant et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2025 ) generate interactive environments conditioned on user or agent actions.
blocks.zh:
视频传播与世界模式. 视频传播模式在高质量视频生成方面取得了重大进展(Yang等人,2025年;Wan等人,2025年;Ali等人,2025年;Agarwal等人,2026年;Ha Cohen等人,2026年)。
大多数采用潜伏扩散(Rombach等人,2021年;Blatmann等人,2023年),其中原始视频使用VAE压缩成潜伏空间.
减少采样步骤的数量,加上因果生成,进一步实现了低纬度视频流(Yin等人,2025年;Huang等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年;Nie等人,2026年;Gu等人,2026年).
它们通过对模型生成的历史进行培训,减少接触偏差,或通过将基于流动的过渡与政策提炼相结合,来改进少步生成。
在这些进步的基础上,互动世界模型(Seo等人,2026年;Nam等人,2026年;Bruce等人,2024年;Team等人,2026年;Mao等人,2026年;Sun等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年;Basant等人,2026年;Yi等人,2025年)创造了以用户或代理行为为条件的互动环境.

blocks.en:
Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction. Traditional reconstruction methods ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ) rely on per-scene optimization, whereas recent feed-forward approaches directly predict 3D geometry from input images in a single forward pass.
They typically predict per-pixel pointmap ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025 ) or 3D Gaussians ( Charatan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) .
Recent works ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhuo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) further introduce streaming formulations that sequentially process incoming images for online reconstruction.
Complementarily, token-based 3DGS methods ( An et al., 2025 ; Veicht et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Yoo et al., 2026 ) decode compact sets of Gaussian primitives from visual or learnable tokens rather than predicting dense per-pixel Gaussians.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward 3D 重建计划. 传统的重建方法(Mildenhall等人,2020年;Kerbl等人,2023年)依靠人均景色优化,而最近的饲料前进方法则直接预测从单个前传的输入图像中的3D几何.
它们通常预测每像素点图(Wang等人,2025a;Lin等人,2025年)或3D Gaussians(Charatan等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年;Xu等人,2025年)。
近代作品(王等人,2025年b;卓等人,2025年;李等人,2025年;陈等人,2025年)进一步引入流式配方,依次处理传入的图像进行在线重建.
作为补充,基于符号的3DGS方法(An等人,2025年;Veicht等人,2026年;Ren等人,2026年;Yoo等人,2026年)从视觉或可学习的符号中解码了高斯原始物的紧凑组,而不是预测密度的每像素高斯人.

blocks.en:
Consistent World Generation. To improve long-term spatial consistency, several world models maintain explicit 3D scene memories, typically represented as point clouds ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) or 3D Gaussians ( Yang et al., 2026 ; De Lutio et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
These methods reconstruct 3D representations from generated frames and render them into subsequent target views to provide spatially grounded conditioning.
Such explicit 3D memories improve consistency and camera controllability, but feed-forward approaches typically rely on dense per-frame reconstruction and continuously accumulate new 3D primitives, causing memory consumption and rendering cost to grow with the generation horizon.
Some methods ( De Lutio et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) use optimization-based reconstruction to maintain a scene-level 3D representation rather than simply accumulating per-frame primitives, but their slow per-scene optimization introduces substantial latency and is difficult to reconcile with real-time generation.
In contrast, L3G-World maintains compact 3D Gaussians as scene memory, by adaptively spawning new primitives or refining existing ones.
Moreover, each Gaussian directly stores VAE latent features, enabling efficient conditioning of the video diffusion model for real-time world generation.
blocks.zh:
一致的世界一代。 为了提高长期空间一致性,若干世界模型保持明显的三维场景记忆,典型表现为点云(Ren等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年a; 沈等人,2026年;李等人,2026年)或3D高斯人(杨等人,2026年;德吕蒂奥等人,2026年;吴等人,2025年).
这些方法从生成的帧中重建了三维表示,并将其转化为后续的目标视角,以提供基于空间的配置.
这种明显的3D记忆可以提高一致性和相机可控性,但向导方法通常依赖于密集的每帧重建,并不断积累新的3D原始物,导致内存消耗和成本随生成地平线增长.
一些方法(De Lutio等人,2026年;Wu等人,2025年)采用优化重建来维持场景级别3D的表示,而不是简单地积累每帧原始物,但其缓慢的人均场景优化引入了实质性的耐久性,难以与实时生成调和.
相比之下,L3G-World保持紧凑的3D高斯人作为场景记忆,方法是适应性地产出新的原始人或完善现有的原始人.
此外,每个高斯人直接存储VAE潜伏特性,为实时世界一代提供视频传播模型的高效配置.

blocks.en: 3.1 Motivation and Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 动机和概述

blocks.en:
Real-time interactive world generation that maintains geometric consistency places two competing demands on a 3D memory.
Consistency over a long horizon requires storing previously generated content, while keeping pace with generation requires a memory that stays compact and fast to read and write. Dense per-frame accumulation stores everything but grows unboundedly, since redundant primitives pile up over the same regions and slow down rendering.
We adopt 3D Gaussians as the memory representation for their robust target-view rendering, and design latent 3D Gaussian memory around two decisions. First, the memory is updated selectively: it spawns new Gaussians only for newly observed geometry and refines existing ones to correct reconstruction errors from earlier steps, so that memory usage remains largely independent of the number of generated frames. Second, each Gaussian stores a VAE latent feature, so that the memory is rendered directly in the latent space of the video generator and conditions the generator without VAE re-encoding.
blocks.zh:
维持几何一致性的实时交互世界代对3D内存提出了两个相互竞争的要求.
在一个长的地平线上保持一致需要存储以前生成的内容,同时与生成同步需要保持紧凑和快速的内存来读写. 由于多余的原始人堆积在同一个地区,并减慢渲染速度,因此每帧积累的强度储存了一切,但无限制地生长。
我们采用3D高斯人作为他们的强性目标视图渲染的记忆代表,并围绕两个决定设计潜在的3D高斯人的记忆. 首先,内存有选择性地更新:它只为新观测到的几何学产生新的高斯人,并完善了现有的几何学,以纠正早期步骤的重建错误,因此内存的使用在很大程度上仍然独立于生成帧的数量. 其次,每个高斯人存储一个VAE潜伏特性,这样内存就直接在视频生成器的潜伏空间中渲染出来,并且给生成器提供没有VAE重编码的条件.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , L3G-World realizes these decisions with two modules that alternate autoregressively: a memory updater, L3G-Mem, which reads and updates the latent 3D Gaussian memory with each generated chunk, and a video generator, L3G-Gen, which generates the next chunk conditioned on the memory rendered in its latent space.
We first present L3G-Mem and the latent 3D Gaussian memory (Sec. 3.2 ), then describe how L3G-Gen is conditioned on the memory and distilled for real-time inference (Sec. 3.3 ), and finally provide the world generation framework L3G-World (Sec. 3.4 ).
Implementation details are provided in Sec. B.1 and Sec. B.2 , respectively.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,L3G-World通过两个自动递归的模块实现这些决定:一个内存更新器L3G-Mem,它用每个生成的块读取和更新潜在的3D高斯记忆,另一个视频生成器L3G-Gen,它生成以在其潜在空间中提供的内存为条件的下一个块.
我们首先呈现L3G-Mem和潜在的3D高斯记忆(Sec. 3.2),然后描述L3G-Gen如何以记忆为条件,并被蒸馏为实时推论(Sec. 3.3),最后提供世界代框架L3G-World(Sec. 3.4).
执行情况详情分别载于Sec.B.1和Sec.B.2。

blocks.en: 3.2 L3G-Mem: 3D Gaussians as World Memory

blocks.en: Adaptive Gaussian Spawning. To keep latent 3D Gaussian memory compact, L3G-Mem selectively spawns new Gaussians only where additional scene geometry is needed. This requires identifying regions that are insufficiently represented by the current memory and initializing spawning query tokens from those regions, leaving well-represented regions to the existing Gaussians. To identify such regions, we render the Gaussians stored in ℳ k − 1 \mathcal{M}_{k-1} from the current camera views 𝐂 k \mathbf{C}_{k} to obtain RGB images and opacity maps. The opacity indicates whether each pixel is covered by the memory, and the per-pixel RGB error against 𝐈 k \mathbf{I}_{k} indicates whether the memory reproduces that pixel faithfully. We mark pixels with low opacity or high error as insufficiently represented, and collect them into a spawn mask 𝐒 k \mathbf{S}_{k} .

blocks.en: The spawn mask then determines where new Gaussians are spawned: we draw the spawning queries from the masked observation, so that the new Gaussians fill the regions marked by 𝐒 k \mathbf{S}_{k} . Thus, rather than clustering over all input geometry features, our updater allocates its spawning budget only to content missing from the memory.

blocks.en: 3.3 L3G-Gen: Memory-conditioned Autoregressive Video Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 L3G- Gen: 内存条件自动递归视频生成

blocks.en:
We introduce L3G-Gen, a memory-conditioned autoregressive video diffusion model for long-horizon world generation.
At each autoregressive step, the model retrieves previously generated information from the persistent 3D Gaussian memory to guide the generation of the next video chunk.
This provides spatially aligned conditioning for preserving scene consistency when revisiting previously explored regions.
To support real-time interaction, we further distill the model into a few-step generator.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了L3G-Gen,这是长视世界一代的内存条件自旋式视频传播模型.
在每一个自旋步骤上,模型检索了之前从持久的3D高斯记忆中生成的信息,以指导下一个视频块的生成.
这为在重新审视先前探索的区域时保持场景一致性提供了空间一致的条件。
为了支持实时交互,我们进一步将模型提炼成几步生成器.

blocks.en:
On-Policy Distillation. To reduce the sampling cost, we distill the memory-conditioned teacher 𝐯 ϕ \mathbf{v}_{\phi} into a few-step autoregressive student following AnyFlow ( Gu et al., 2026 ) .
The student is conditioned on both the source and destination noise levels and learns flow-map transitions between arbitrary points along the denoising trajectory.
After flow-map initialization, we jointly optimize the flow-map objective and on-policy distribution matching.
Specifically, the student generates samples through its own autoregressive rollout, which are re-noised and compared against the frozen teacher through distribution matching.
Training on the student’s own generation trajectory, rather than relying solely on noisy ground-truth samples, reduces the train–test mismatch in few-step autoregressive generation.
Detailed distillation objectives and training configurations are provided in Sec. A.1 .

blocks.en: 3.4 L3G-World: Consistent World Generation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.4 L3G-世界:协调一致的世界世代框架

blocks.en: Figure 4: L3G-World Pipeline. L3G-World couples video generation and memory updating in a chunk-wise loop, where each generated chunk updates the persistent 3D memory, which in turn conditions subsequent chunk generation.
blocks.zh: 图4 L3G-世界管道. L3G-World parames 视频生成和内存更新以块形循环进行,其中每个生成的块更新了持久的3D内存,这反过来又给随后的块形生成带来了条件.

blocks.en:
Combining L3G-Mem and L3G-Gen, L3G-World performs world generation through an autoregressive loop of adaptive memory update and memory-conditioned video generation.
Given an input image, L3G-Mem first initializes the persistent Gaussian memory ℳ 0 \mathcal{M}_{0} .
At each generation step k k , the VAE features stored in ℳ k − 1 \mathcal{M}_{k-1} are rendered from the target cameras 𝐂 k \mathbf{C}_{k} to provide spatially aligned latent conditioning for L3G-Gen.
Importantly, we directly render memory in the VAE latent space, avoiding RGB rendering followed by VAE re-encoding.
blocks.zh:
结合L3G-Mem和L3G-Gen,L3G-World通过适应性内存更新和内存条件视频生成的自旋循环来进行世界生成.
鉴于一个输入图像,L3G-Mem首先初始化了持久的高斯记忆M 0\mathcal{M}_{0}.
在每代步骤 k k 中,存储在 M k − 1\ mathcal{ M}_{k-1} 的 VAE 特性从目标相机 C k\ mathbf{ C}_{k} 中渲染出来,为 L3G- Gen 提供空间对齐的潜伏条件.
重要的是,我们直接在VAE潜伏空间中制造内存,避免了RGB渲染后VAE重编码.

blocks.en:
Conditioned on the rendered memory, L3G-Gen generates the next video chunk in the VAE latent space.
These generated latents are passed directly to L3G-Mem for VAE feature lifting, while the corresponding RGB frames are obtained once through the VAE decoder.
The updater then update the memory, producing ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} for the next generation step.
By repeatedly reading from and writing back to the same persistent 3D memory, L3G-World continuously extends and corrects the generated world while avoiding redundant latent encoding between the two modules. L3G-World Fast employ few-step student model of L3G-Gen, enabling real-time world generation.
blocks.zh:
L3G-Gen在制成的内存上附加条件,生成VAE潜在空间中的下一个视频块.
这些生成的潜伏物直接传递到L3G-Mem用于VAE特性提升,而相应的RGB帧则通过VAE解码器一次获得.
更新器随后更新内存,为下一代步骤生成Mk\ mathcal{M}_{k}.
L3G-World通过反复读取和写回相同的持续3D内存,不断延伸和校正生成的世界,同时避免两个模块之间冗余的潜在编码. L3G- 世界组织 Fast使用L3G-Gen的几步学生模式,使实时世界一代成为可能.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We implement L3G-Mem inspired by ZipSplat ( Veicht et al., 2026 ) , using Depth Anything 3 (DA3) ( Lin et al., 2025 ) as the geometry backbone. For L3G-Gen, we adopt Cosmos-Predict2.5 ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . We train L3G-Mem on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , and L3G-Gen on DL3DV and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) . We fine-tune Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone of the video generator using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , and we adopt AnyFlow ( Gu et al., 2026 ) for few-step distillation. We refer to the few-step distilled variant as ‘L3G-World Fast’ in our experiments. All models are optimized using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, with a batch size of 8 and 16 for the memory updater and world model, respectively. The implementation and training details of the memory updater and video DiT are provided in Sec. B.1 and B.2 .
blocks.zh: 执行详情。 我们实施受ZipSplatz(Veicht等人,2026年)启发的L3G-Mem,使用深度Anything 3(DA3)(Lin等人,2025年)作为几何主干. 对于L3G-Gen,我们采用Cosmos-Predict2.5(NVIDIA等人,2025年)。 我们在DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年)上列车L3G-Mem,在DL3DV和RealEstate10K(周等人,2018年)上列车L3G-Gen. 我们利用LORA(Hu等人,2022年)微调视频生成器的传播变形器(DIT)骨干,我们采用AnyFlow(Gu等人,2026年)进行几步蒸馏. 我们在实验中将几步蒸馏的变体称为“L3G-World Fast”。 所有型号均在4台NVIDIA A100 GPU上使用AdamW(Loshchilov和Hutter,2017)进行优化,分批大小分别为8和16,用于内存更新器和世界型号. 记忆更新器和视频DiT的执行和培训细节见Sec.B.1和B.2。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare L3G-World against state-of-the-art world models with either explicit or implicit memory, including point-cloud-based methods, Lyra 2.0 ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , Spatia ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , SPMem ( Wu et al., 2026a ) , and 3DScenePrompt ( Lee et al., 2026 ) ; the Gaussian-based method NeoVerse ( Yang et al., 2026 ) ; and temporal-context-based methods, Yume 1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) and Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . For a fair comparison in our single-image setting, we use Depth Anything 3 GIANT-1.1-NESTED ( Lin et al., 2025 ) to obtain metric depth for all explicit 3D-memory methods, aligning the scale of the reconstructed scene representation with the evaluation camera trajectory. For Gaussian-based methods, including NeoVerse and L3G-World, we align the initially predicted Gaussian geometry to the same metric depth. All methods are evaluated on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, including the efficiency measurements. Detailed baseline configurations are provided in Sec. B.3 .

B.3节提供了详细的基线配置。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Benchmark. We evaluate L3G-World and all baselines on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) . To evaluate long-horizon spatial consistency, we construct 481-frame loop-closure trajectories that explore away from the initial view and then retrace the same camera path in reverse. We measure self-consistency by comparing generated frames at corresponding camera poses along the outgoing and returning trajectories using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
For generation quality, we report LPIPS, FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , and four VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) metrics: Imaging Quality (IQ), Aesthetic Quality (AQ), Subject Consistency (SC), and Background Consistency (BC). Following ( Seo et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate camera controllability using translation error (TransErr) and rotation error (RotErr), and evaluate geometric consistency using MEt3R ( Asim et al., 2025 ) , following ( Jang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
评价基准。 我们评价L3G-World以及DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年)和RealEstate10K(Zhou等人,2018年)上的所有基线. 为了评价长视距空间一致性,我们构建了481帧的环闭轨距,这些轨距从最初的视野中探索,然后逆向重寻同一相机路径. 我们用PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS等方法,在向外和返回的轨迹上,通过相应的相机布置来比较生成的帧,来测量自我一致性.
对于生成质量,我们报告LPIPS,FID(Heusel等人,2017年),以及四个V Bench(Huang等人,2024年)的度量衡:成像质量(IQ),审美质量(AQ),主题一致性(SC)和背景一致性(BC). 随后(Seo等人,2026年),我们使用翻译错误(TransErr)和旋转错误(RotErr)评价相机可控性,并使用Met3R(Asim等人,2025年)评价几何一致性,随后(Jang等人,2026年).

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化结果

blocks.en: Tab. 2 compares L3G-World and L3G-World Fast with the baselines in terms of long-horizon self-consistency, memory efficiency, generation quality, camera pose accuracy, and 3D consistency.
blocks.zh: Tab. 2将L3G-World和L3G-World Fast在长视自相容性,内存效率,生成质量,相机形成精度,3D一致性等方面与基线进行比较.

blocks.en:
Memory Efficiency. Compared with NeoVerse, a Gaussian-based method, L3G-World uses 266–417 × \times fewer primitives and 42–67 × \times less memory across the two datasets.
Its compact representation enables 8.3–10.4 × \times faster RGB rendering, while directly rendering the stored VAE latent features increases VAE-conditioning throughput by 349–359 × \times . The advantage also holds against point-cloud-based memories.
Compared with Lyra 2.0, a particularly efficient point-cloud baseline, L3G-World performs memory reconstruction 8.9–9.5 × \times faster while using 7.8–10.4 × \times less memory, and achieves 643–648 × \times higher VAE-rendering throughput. These gains directly reflect our two design choices: instead of accumulating dense primitives, L3G-Mem adds Gaussians only for previously uncovered or high-error regions and updates existing ones; moreover, storing VAE features in each Gaussian eliminates the cost of VAE re-encoding required for conditioning the DiT.

blocks.en: Self-Consistency. On DL3DV, the two L3G-World variants achieve the best and second-best PSNR and LPIPS, with L3G-World obtaining the best scores. On RealEstate10K, L3G-World further achieves the best PSNR and LPIPS, and the second-best SSIM. These results support our motivation that a persistent, spatially anchored scene memory can preserve previously observed content when the camera revisits a region after long-horizon exploration.

Generation Quality and 3D Consistency. Importantly, these efficiency gains are accompanied by strong generation quality.

On RealEstate10K, L3G-World achieves the best LPIPS, FID, SC, and BC, together with the second-best IQ. For camera control, L3G-World achieves the lowest translation error and second-lowest rotation error on DL3DV. While other baselines achieve lower pose and MEt3R errors on RealEstate10K, L3G-World maintains strong generation quality and long-horizon self-consistency.

在DL3DV上,L3G-World实现最佳LPIPS,FID,SC,和BC,而L3G-World Fast则获得最佳智商和AQ. 在RealEstate10K上,L3G-World实现了最佳LPIPS,FID,SC,和BC,以及第二佳智商. 对于相机控制,L3G-World在DL3DV上实现了最低的翻译错误和第二低的旋转错误. 虽然其他基线在RealEstate10K上实现了较低的姿势和Met3R差错,但L3G-World却保持了强生成质量和长视距自我一致性.

Fig. 5 presents qualitative results of L3G-World.
As shown in (a), L3G-Mem corrects geometric errors in the persistent 3D memory using observations from the next video chunk.
Specifically, rendering the memory ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} from chunk k k into the camera views of chunk k + 1 k{+}1 reveals geometric errors (red bounding box).
Using the newly generated video chunk k + 1 k{+}1 , L3G-Mem refines the existing Gaussians while spawning new ones in previously unobserved regions.
This adaptive memory update enables L3G-World to maintain a compact and efficient 3D memory while preserving scene consistency throughout minute-long autoregressive generation (b).
Furthermore, by rendering the memory’s VAE features from target camera views, L3G-World provides spatially aligned conditioning to extrapolate the world from an input image along diverse camera trajectories (c).

具体地说,将 M k\ mathcal{M}_{k} 从块 k k 转换到块 k + 1 k{+}1 的相机视图中会显示几何错误(红色边框) 。

此外,L3G-World通过将内存的VAE特性从目标相机视图中渲染出来,提供空间对齐的调制,以按照不同的相机轨迹(c)从输入图像中推断世界。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 presents qualitative comparisons under long-horizon loop-closure trajectories. For each scene, all methods start from the same input view, explore previously unseen regions, and eventually return to the initial camera location; thus, the final frame directly reveals whether the generated world remains consistent after long-horizon exploration. Temporal-context-based methods, Matrix-Game 3.0 and Yume 1.5, often exhibit noticeable appearance or geometric drift when returning to previously observed regions. Among explicit 3D-memory approaches, Spatia and NeoVerse show substantial blur and rendering artifacts as generation progresses, while GEN3C and Lyra 2.0 produce comparatively stronger results but often struggle to extrapolate plausible geometry and appearance far beyond the single input view. In contrast, L3G-World preserves scene structure and appearance throughout long-horizon exploration and recovers a visually consistent scene upon loop closure. L3G-World Distill also retains this behavior while enabling few-step generation. Additional qualitative comparisons with all baselines are provided in Sec. C .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented L3G-World, a compact 3D Gaussian memory for real-time, spatially consistent world generation.
Instead of accumulating dense primitives from every generated chunk, our feed-forward memory updater spawns new Gaussians only in regions insufficiently covered by the memory and refines existing ones in previously reconstructed regions, keeping the memory compact and fast to render. Each Gaussian further carries a VAE-space feature, so the memory can be rendered directly into the latent space of the DiT without VAE re-encoding, which makes memory conditioning efficient enough for real-time generation. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality in terms of long-horizon spatial consistency, while substantially reducing the cost of memory reconstruction, rendering, and storage. We believe that compact, latent-space 3D memories offer a practical foundation for scalable interactive world models.

blocks.en: B.2 Video Diffusion Model Details
blocks.zh: B.2 视频传播模型细节

blocks.en: B.2.1 Teacher Model
blocks.zh: B.2.1 教师模式

blocks.en:
Architecture. We build the teacher model on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) .
The pretrained DiT backbone is kept frozen, while LoRA adapters, the UCPE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) camera-conditioning branches, and the widened input projection are trained.
For memory conditioning, the noisy video latent is channel-concatenated with the VAE feature rendered from the current latent 3D Gaussian memory, together with its validity mask and conditioning indicator.
We additionally retrieve up to three previously observed latents according to camera-pose proximity and provide them as clean reference tokens.
blocks.zh:
建筑学. 我们在宇宙-预测2.5-2B(Ali等人,2025年)上建立了教师模型。
预训的DiT主干线保持冷冻,而LORA适配器,UCPE(Zhang等人,2026年)相机空调分支以及拓宽的输入投影则经过培训.
对于内存调节,喧闹的视频潜伏与当前潜伏的3D高斯内存所制成的VAE特性及其有效性罩和调制指示器相配合.
另外,我们根据相机的接近程度,还回收了最多三个以前观察到的潜伏物,并作为干净的参考物提供。

blocks.en:
Training. We train the teacher using rectified flow matching on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) .
The anchor frame is provided as a clean image latent and excluded from the denoising loss, while the remaining target latents are jointly denoised with full bidirectional attention.
During training, we randomly drop text and reconstruction conditioning and vary the number of retrieved reference latents to improve robustness to different conditioning configurations.
The teacher is fine-tuned with rank-16 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) together with the UCPE modules and input projection.
blocks.zh:
培训。 校对:Soup

在训练期间,我们随机放下文字和重建条件,并改变检索的参考潜质数量,以提高强度,使其适应不同的条件配置。
该教师与16级LORA适配器(Hu等人,2022年)以及UCPE模块和输入投影进行了微调.

blocks.en:
Inference. At inference, the teacher generates one 81-frame clip at a time using 35 denoising steps with classifier-free guidance Ho and Salimans (2022) .
After each generated clip, the reconstructed scene memory is updated from the generated observations and rendered under the cameras of the next clip.
Reference latents are retrieved only from the generated history, and the final generated frame is used to initialize the following clip.

每次生成剪辑后,重建的场景内存会从生成的观测结果中更新,并在下一个剪辑的摄像头下进行渲染.
参考潜质只从生成的历史中检索,最后生成的框架用于初始化以下剪辑.

blocks.en: B.2.2 Student Model
blocks.zh: B.2.2 学生模式

blocks.en:
Architecture. The student retains the same backbone, reconstruction conditioning, reference conditioning, and UCPE camera modules ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) as the teacher, but converts the bidirectional DiT into a chunk-causal autoregressive model.
Each training clip is divided into short latent chunks, and the current chunk attends to compressed long-term history, retrieved reference latents, and the most recent full-resolution chunks.
Older history is spatially compressed, while the two most recent chunks remain at the original latent resolution.
At inference, the corresponding keys and values are cached independently for the standard self-attention and UCPE attention branches.
blocks.zh:
建筑学. 学生保留与老师相同的骨干,重建调节,参考调节,以及UCPE相机模块(张等人,2026年),但将双向DiT转换成块-因果自递模型.
每个训练片段被分为短的潜在块,目前的块用于压缩长期历史、检索参考潜在块和最新的全分辨率块。
古老的历史在空间上是压缩的,而最近的两个块仍然停留在原始的潜在分辨率。
推论,相应的密钥和值会独立为标准自觉和UCPE关注分支缓存.

blocks.en:
Flow-Map Distillation. We first initialize the student through flow-map distillation following AnyFlow ( Gu et al., 2026 ) .
Unlike the teacher, which predicts the instantaneous denoising velocity at a single noise level, the student is conditioned on both the source and destination noise levels and learns transitions between arbitrary points along the denoising trajectory.
Training combines standard diffusion, direct consistency, and intermediate flow-map transitions.
We initialize the student from the teacher and increase the LoRA rank to 128, while preserving the teacher initialization for the shared camera and reconstruction-conditioning modules.

与老师在单个噪声级别上预测瞬间去声速度不同的是,学生在源噪声级别和目的地噪声级别上都有条件,并学习沿去声轨迹任意点之间的过渡.
培训结合了标准传播,直接一致性,中间流图过渡.
我们从教师中初始化学生,并将LORA排名提高到128名,同时保留共享相机和重建-空调模块的教师初始化.

blocks.en:
On-Policy Distillation and Inference. We further train the student with on-policy distribution matching using samples generated from its own autoregressive rollouts.
A frozen teacher provides the real-data score, while a trainable copy of the teacher estimates the student distribution, and the flow-map objective ( Boffi et al., 2024 ) is retained during this stage for stable optimization.
At inference, the student generates three latent frames per autoregressive step using 4 denoising steps without classifier-free guidance.
The generated latents are continuously added to the reference pool and periodically used to update the latent 3D Gaussian memory, which is then rendered to provide reconstruction guidance for subsequent chunks.

blocks.en: B.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: B.3 基线

blocks.en: Depth and Scale Alignment. Our evaluation considers a single-image-to-video setting, where the explicit 3D-memory baselines ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) must initialize their scene representation from a single input image. This introduces a scale ambiguity between the monocularly reconstructed 3D scene and the metric camera trajectory used for evaluation, which can lead to incorrectly rendered target views even when the reconstructed geometry is otherwise accurate. To ensure a consistent metric scale across methods, we use Depth Anything 3 GIANT-1.1-NESTED ( Lin et al., 2025 ) as the depth estimator for all explicit 3D-memory baselines. The predicted metric depth is used to place the reconstructed 3D representation at the same scale as the evaluation camera trajectory. For Gaussian-based methods, NeoVerse ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and L3G-World, we additionally align the depth rendered from the initially predicted Gaussians with the metric depth estimated from the input image.
blocks.zh: 深度和比例对齐。 我们的评估考虑采用单一图像到视频的设定,其中明确的3D模型基线(Ren等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026a年; Shen et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 )必须从单一输入图像中初始化他们的场景表现. 这在单向重建的3D场景和用于评价的度量相机轨迹之间引入了尺度模糊,这可能导致不正确地渲染目标视图,即使重建的几何学在其他方面是准确的. 为保证各方法的尺度一致,我们使用深度Anything 3 GIANT-1.1-NESTED(Lin等人,2025年)作为所有明确的3D-映射基线的深度估计器。 预测的度量深度用于将重建的立体表示与评价相机轨迹的大小相同. 对于基于高斯的方法,NeoVerse(Yang等人,2026年)和L3G-World,我们额外调整了最初预测的高斯人给出的深度与输入图像估计的度量深度.

blocks.en: Baseline Implementations. The official implementations of SPMem ( Wu et al., 2026a ) and 3DScenePrompt ( Lee et al., 2026 ) initialize their first generation chunk using multiple input views or video frames, from which they reconstruct a 3D point-cloud representation and render it under subsequent target cameras. Since our benchmark provides only a single input image, we modify their initialization stage to reconstruct the 3D representation from the first frame alone and render it to the target cameras of the first chunk. For subsequent autoregressive generation chunks, we retain the behavior of the official implementations.
blocks.zh: 基线执行情况。 SPMem(Wu等人,2026a)和3DSceenePrompt(Lee等人,2026年)的正式实施,通过多个输入视图或视频帧初始化了他们的第一代块,从中他们重建了3D点云表示,并在后续的目标摄像头下制作. 由于我们的基准只提供单一的输入图像,我们修改了它们的初始化阶段,从第一个帧单独重建3D代表,并将其变成第一个块的目标摄像头. 对于之后的自动生成块,我们保留了官方执行的行为.

blocks.en: NeoVerse ( Yang et al., 2026 ) is designed for single-image world generation, but its released implementation does not provide the complete autoregressive generation pipeline required by our long-horizon evaluation. We therefore build an autoregressive inference pipeline on top of the official implementation, repeatedly reconstructing and updating its Gaussian representation from generated observations and rendering the resulting memory under the target cameras for subsequent generation.
blocks.zh: NeoVerse(Yang等人,2026年)是针对单像世界一代设计的,但其发布的执行并不能提供我们长视距评价所需的完全自旋生成管道. 因此,我们在正式执行之前建造了一个自动推论管道,从产生的观测结果中反复重建和更新其高斯式表述,并将由此产生的内存置于目标摄像头下,供下一代使用。

blocks.en: Yume 1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) and Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) are action-conditioned world models that use discrete keyboard-style controls rather than continuous camera parameters. To evaluate them along the same camera trajectories as the other methods, we convert the provided camera motion into the corresponding sequence of discrete action inputs and use these actions for autoregressive generation.
blocks.zh: Yume 1.5(Mao等人,2026年)和Matrix-Game 3.0(Wang等人,2026年)是具有动作条件的世界模型,使用离散键盘式控制而不是连续相机参数. 为了按照与其他方法相同的相机轨迹来评价它们,我们把所提供的相机运动转换成相应的离散动作输入序列,并利用这些动作进行自旋生成.

blocks.en: B.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.4 评价

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate L3G-World and all baselines on the test splits of DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) . To explicitly evaluate long-horizon consistency under revisitation, we construct 481-frame loop-closure trajectories. Starting from the input view, the camera first follows an exploration trajectory and subsequently retraces the same trajectory in reverse, eventually returning to the initial camera pose.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价L3G-World以及DL3DV(Ling等人,2024年)和RealEstate10K(Zhou等人,2018年)的测试分数上的所有基线. 为了在重新审视中明确评价长距离一致性,我们构建了481帧环闭轨距. 从输入视图开始,相机首先遵循探索轨迹,然后逆向重追踪相同的轨迹,最终返回初始相机姿势.

blocks.en: Self-Consistency. The loop-closure trajectory provides pairs of generated frames corresponding to the same camera pose but generated at different points in the autoregressive sequence. We pair each frame on the outgoing trajectory with its corresponding frame on the returning trajectory and compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS between them. We report the average over all corresponding frame pairs as our self-consistency metrics. This evaluation directly measures whether scene appearance and structure are preserved after long-horizon generation and subsequent loop closure.
blocks.zh: 自性坚固. 循环闭塞轨迹提供了对应同一相机姿势的生成帧的对数,但在自动递归序列的不同点生成. 我们在向导轨迹上将每个框架与返回轨迹上的相应框架对齐,并在它们之间计算PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS. 我们报告所有相应框架对的平均值,作为我们自我维持的衡量标准。 这一评价直接衡量场景外观和结构是否在长视野生成及随后的环闭后得以保存.

blocks.en: Camera Controllability. Following ( Seo et al., 2026 ) , we estimate the camera trajectory from each generated video using the feed-forward geometry estimator ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , and compare the estimated trajectory against the ground-truth camera trajectory used for generation. We report translation error (TransErr) after resolving the global scale ambiguity of the estimated trajectory, together with rotation error (RotErr) in degrees.
blocks.zh: 相机可控性. 随后(Seo等人,2026年),我们利用向导几何估计仪(Lin等人,2025年)估算每段生成的视频的相机轨迹,并将估计轨迹与用于生成的地面真实相机轨迹进行比较。 我们在解决了估计轨迹的全球范围模糊性以及旋转误差(RotErr)后,报告翻译错误(TransErr)。

blocks.en: Efficiency. For explicit 3D-memory methods, we measure the number of stored 3D primitives and their memory footprint after long-horizon generation, together with memory reconstruction throughput in processed views per second. We further measure target-view rendering throughput in two settings: RGB rendering FPS and VAE-space conditioning FPS. For methods whose 3D memory stores only RGB appearance, VAE-space conditioning includes both target-view RGB rendering and subsequent VAE encoding. In contrast, L3G-World directly renders the stored VAE features into the target-view latent space without RGB rendering or re-encoding. Reconstruction FPS includes Gaussian retrieval, mask computation, the updater forward pass, and the residual update. All efficiency measurements in Tab. 2 are performed on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 效率。 对于明晰的3D-映射方法,我们测量了长视距生成后存储的3D原始体的数量及其记忆足迹,以及每秒处理的视图中的记忆重建吞吐量. 我们进一步在两种环境下测量目标视图渲染的吞吐量:RGB渲染FPS和VAE-空间配置FPS. 对于只存储了RGB外观的3D内存的方法,VAE-空间配置既包括目标视图RGB渲染,也包括随后的VAE编码. 相比之下,L3G-World直接使存储的VAE特性进入目标视图潜在空间,而无需RGB渲染或重新编码. 重建FPS包括高斯检索,面具计算,更新器前传,以及剩余更新. 所有效率测量在Tab。 2在单NVIDIA A100 GPU上进行.

blocks.en: Appendix C Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 定性 结果

blocks.en: Figure 8: Additional qualitative results of video generation on DL3DV and RealEstate10K. For each scene, all methods start from the same input view (top), explore unseen regions (middle), and return to the initial camera location (bottom). L3G-World preserves scene structure and appearance upon loop closure, whereas the baselines exhibit drift, blur, or rendering artifacts.
blocks.zh: 图8:DL3DV和RealEstate10K上视频生成的其他定性结果. 对于每个场景,所有的方法都从相同的输入视图(上)开始,探索看不见的区域(中),返回初始相机位置(下). L3G-World在环闭合时保留了场景结构和外观,而基线显示的是漂移、模糊或渲染文物。

blocks.en:
Fig. 8 extends the comparison in Fig. 6 to additional scenes from DL3DV and RealEstate10K under the same long-horizon loop-closure trajectories. Starting from the same input view, each method explores previously unseen regions and eventually returns to the initial camera location, so that the final frame directly reveals whether the generated world remains consistent after long-horizon exploration.
The baselines exhibit distinct failure modes.
Temporal-context-based methods, Yume 1.5 and Matrix-Game 3.0, generally follow the camera motion during exploration, but fail to preserve spatial consistency upon return: the final frame often shows a layout or appearance different from the input view, and in some cases even a different viewpoint, indicating that camera control also degrades over the long trajectory.
Among explicit 3D memories, SPMem tends to hallucinate inconsistent content once the camera leaves the initially observed region, and NeoVerse progressively collapses into blurry textures over the long trajectory.
Among the baselines that return to the starting scene more reliably, GEN3C recovers the input view quite well, but struggles to extrapolate plausible content in regions unseen in the input view, producing distorted or incomplete frames during exploration.
Lyra 2.0 returns reasonably close to the input view, but its final frame is still not fully spatially aligned with it, indicating drift from the original scene.
In contrast, L3G-World both generates plausible content in unseen regions and returns to a scene spatially aligned with the input view in both structure and appearance, as its latent 3D Gaussian memory anchors previously generated content while continually refining it throughout exploration.
blocks.zh:
图8将图6中的比较扩展至DL3DV和RealEstate10K在同一长视环闭路轨迹下的额外场景. 从相同的输入视图开始,每种方法都探索以前未见的区域,并最终返回最初的相机位置,这样最终的帧就可以直接揭示生成的世界在长视距探索后是否仍然一致.
基线显示不同的故障模式。
基于Temperal-context的方法,Yume 1.5和Matrix-Game 3.0,一般在探索时跟随相机运动,但在返回时未能保持空间一致性:最终帧往往显示布局或外观与输入视图不同,在某些情况下甚至有不同的观点,表明相机控制在长轨上也会退化.
在清晰的3D记忆中,SPMem在镜头离开最初观察到的区域后往往会产生不连贯内容的幻觉,NeoVerse在长轨上逐渐崩溃成模糊的纹理.
在更可靠地返回起始场景的基线中,GEN3C恢复了相当好的输入视图,但在输入视图中看不见的区域却难以推断出可信的内容,在勘探过程中产生扭曲或不完整的帧。
Lyra 2.0 返回时与输入视图相当接近,但其最终帧仍没有完全与它空间对齐,表明从原始场景漂移.
与此相对照,L3G-World既在看不见的区域产生可信的内容,又在空间上与结构和外观上的输入视图保持一致,因为其潜在的3D高斯记忆锚原生成内容,同时在整个探索过程中不断加以完善。

blocks.en: Appendix D Comparison with Online 3DGS Methods
blocks.zh: 附录D 与在线3DGS的比较 方法

blocks.en: Existing online 3D Gaussian Splatting methods Cheng et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2026a) provide strong feed-forward reconstruction and could, in principle, serve as an external 3D memory for world generation. However, these methods are primarily designed for high-fidelity reconstruction and novel-view synthesis (NVS), whereas a memory for real-time world generation must satisfy a different operating regime: it must be continuously updated throughout autoregressive generation, remain compact as exploration proceeds, and render the conditioning signal for every subsequent video chunk with very low latency. In particular, a dense representation that is effective for reconstruction can introduce substantial memory and rendering overhead when repeatedly queried by a video diffusion model. Our goal is therefore not to outperform dedicated online 3DGS methods as a standalone reconstruction system, but to construct a sufficiently faithful 3D memory that can be efficiently updated and directly consumed by L3G-Gen.
blocks.zh: 现有在线 3D 高斯电镀法 Cheng等人(2026年);陈等人(2026年a)提供了强大的饲料前期重建,原则上可以作为世界一代的外部3D记忆. 然而,这些方法主要是为高真性重建和新视觉合成(NVS)设计的,而实时世界一代的记忆必须满足不同的操作系统:它必须在整个自动递归的生成过程中不断更新,在勘探过程中保持紧凑,并且使每个随后的视频块的调制信号都非常低缓. 特别是,如果通过视频传播模式反复询问,对重建有效的密集表述可带来大量记忆和间接费用。 因此,我们的目标不是将专用的在线3DGS方法作为一个独立的重建系统来完成,而是构建一个足够忠实的3D内存,可以被L3G-Gen高效更新和直接消耗.

blocks.en: To characterize this trade-off quantitatively, we evaluate latent 3D Gaussian memory with online 3D Gaussian reconstruction models Cheng et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2026a) on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , and additionally on RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) for out-of-domain generalization. We process each sequence online in streaming chunks of nine frames. After each chunk processing, we render the current 3D Gaussians to four target viewpoints and evaluate both RGB- and VAE-space NVS. We report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS for RGB NVS, and mean squared error (MSE) and cosine similarity between the rendered and ground-truth VAE latents. We additionally measure the number of stored primitives, memory footprint, reconstruction FPS, and VAE rendering throughput to evaluate the efficiency required for repeated memory updates and queries during world generation.
blocks.zh: 为了从数量上描述这种权衡,我们用在线的3D高斯重建模型来评价潜在的3D高斯记忆 Cheng et al. (2026); Chen et al. (2026a) on DL3DV (Ling et al., 2024),另外在RealEstate10K (Zhou et al., 2018)上为域外通用. 我们在线处理每个序列 在流块 9帧。 在每次块处理后,我们都会使目前的3D高斯人达到四个目标角度,并同时评价RGB-和VAE-space NVS. 我们为 RGB NVS 报告 PSNR, SSIM, 和 LPIPS , 并指正方形误差( MSE) , 以及所渲染的和地面真实的 VAE 潜伏的 余弦相似性 。 我们额外测量了存储原始物的数量,内存足迹,重建FPS,以及VAE渲染的吞吐量,以评价世界一代中重复内存更新和查询所需的效率.

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 6 , latent 3D Gaussian memory is substantially more efficient than dedicated online 3DGS methods ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . Compared with ReCoSplat ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) at 480 × 480 480\times 480 , latent 3D Gaussian memory uses approximately 49 49 – 53 × 53\times fewer primitives and 13 13 – 14 × 14\times less memory across the two datasets, while updating the memory about 2.5 2.5 – 2.6 × 2.6\times faster.
Moreover, since these methods store only RGB Gaussians, conditioning a latent video generator requires rendering RGB images and re-encoding them with the VAE, whereas latent 3D Gaussian memory directly renders its stored VAE features, achieving 245 245 – 430 × 430\times higher VAE rendering throughput.
Despite this compact representation, latent 3D Gaussian memory retains meaningful reconstruction fidelity: at our target resolution of 480 × 832 480\times 832 , it substantially improves both RGB- and VAE-space NVS over ReCoSplat on both datasets, and outperforms OF 3 GS ( Chen et al., 2026a ) while operating at a higher resolution. ReCoSplat at the lower 480 × 480 480\times 480 resolution achieves higher fidelity, which is expected from a method specifically optimized for high-quality NVS. We therefore view these reconstruction metrics not as a standalone reconstruction benchmark, but as an objective measure that latent 3D Gaussian memory preserves sufficiently accurate spatial and latent information while satisfying the much stricter memory and throughput requirements of real-time world generation.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所示. 6,潜在的3D高斯记忆比专用的在线3DGS方法要高效得多(Cheng等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年a). 与480×480\时的ReCoSplat(Cheng et al., 2026)相比,潜伏的3D高斯记忆使用约4949 — 53×53\时更少原始人,1313 — 14×14\时更少两个数据集的内存,同时更新内存约2.52.5 —2.6×2.6\时更快.
此外,由于这些方法只存储 RGB Gaussians , 配置潜在视频生成器需要渲染 RGB 图像并将其与 VAE 重编码, 而潜在的 3D Gaussian 内存则直接使其存储的 VAE 特性, 实现 245 – 430 × 430\ 的 VAE 渲染吞吐量更高.
尽管有这种紧凑的表示,潜在的3D Gaussian内存仍然保留着有意义的重建忠心:在我们480×832 480\times 832的目标分辨率上,它在两个数据集上的RGB-和VAE-space NVS都大大改进了ReCoSplate,并在运行的更高分辨率上超过了3GS(Chen等人,2026a). ReCoSplate at the lower 480 × 480 480\times 480分辨率达到了更高的忠诚度,从一种专门为高质量NVS优化的方法中可以预期到这一点. 因此,我们认为这些重建指标不是一个独立的重建基准,而是作为客观的衡量标准,即潜在的3D高斯记忆保存了足够准确的空间和潜在信息,同时满足了实时世界一代更严格的记忆和吞吐量要求。

We evaluate online reconstruction on DL3DV and on RealEstate10K, reporting RGB and VAE latent novel view synthesis quality together with memory size, reconstruction FPS, and VAE rendering FPS. Reconstruction FPS is computed from nine-frame update chunks. The best and second-best results within each dataset are shown in bold and underline , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表6:在线NVS评价. 我们在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上评价在线重建,报告RGB和VAE潜在小说视图合成质量与内存大小,重建FPS,以及VAE渲染FPS. 重建FPS是根据九帧更新块计算的。 每个数据集的最佳结果和次最佳结果分别以粗体和下划线表示。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Visualization of latent 3D Gaussian memory conditioning for video generation. We visualize the ground-truth and generated video, with target-view rendered VAE condition from the latent 3D Gaussian memory, illustrating that spatially aligned latent memory provides consistent conditioning for video generation.
blocks.zh: 图9 潜在3D高斯记忆构型可视化用于视频生成. 我们可视化地面真实和生成的视频,目标视图从潜在的3D高斯记忆中制作出VAE条件,说明空间对齐的潜在记忆为视频生成提供了一致的配置.

blocks.en: More importantly, the utility of this reconstruction is determined by how the memory conditions subsequent video generation. Fig. 9 visualizes, for each target camera, the ground-truth view, the generated view, and the VAE condition directly rendered from latent 3D Gaussian memory. The rendered latent remains spatially aligned with the target camera and preserves the structure of previously observed regions. By directly conditioning L3G-Gen on these spatially anchored VAE features, the model can generate novel content while remaining consistent with the persistent scene memory. Thus, latent 3D Gaussian memory is not merely an efficient reconstruction module: it provides a compact, continuously updated, and directly renderable latent interface between the accumulated 3D scene and autoregressive video generation.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,这种重建的效用是由记忆条件如何后续的视频生成决定的. 图9可视化,每个目标相机,地面真实视图,生成的视图,以及由潜伏的3D高斯记忆直接渲染的VAE条件. 形成的潜在物与目标相机在空间上保持一致,并保持了以前观测到的区域的结构。 通过在这些空间定位的VAE特性上直接调制L3G-Gen,该模型可以生成新内容,同时保持与持续场景内存的一致性. 因此,潜伏的3D高斯记忆不仅仅是一个高效的重建模块:它提供了一个紧凑的,不断更新的,在累积的3D场景和自递式视频生成之间直接可转换的潜在界面.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Despite its efficiency, L3G-World has several limitations that suggest directions for future work. First, latent 3D Gaussian memory is primarily designed for static scenes and does not explicitly model independently moving objects. Extending the persistent memory to disentangle dynamic content from static geometry would enable more general interactive environments. Second, although the memory grows with explored spatial extent rather than generation length, its size can still increase under extremely large-scale exploration; adaptive pruning or hierarchical memory representations could further improve scalability. Finally, while the refinement mechanism can progressively correct inaccurate Gaussians, errors introduced during long-horizon autoregressive generation may still propagate to subsequent memory updates.
blocks.zh: L3G-World尽管效率很高,但有若干局限性,为今后的工作指明了方向。 首先,潜伏的3D高斯记忆主要是为静态场景设计的,并没有明确地模拟独立移动的物体. 将持续的内存扩展至将动态内容与静态几何区分开来,将促成更普遍的交互环境. 第二,虽然内存以探索的空间范围而不是生成长度增长,但在极大规模的探索下,它的体积仍然可以增加;适应性穿梭或层次性内存表现可以进一步提高可扩展性. 最后,虽然完善机制可以逐步纠正不准确的高斯人,但长视自递增生成过程中引入的错误可能仍然会传播到后续的内存更新中.
